applies_to: Belimo CQ24A-BAC rotary actuator for CQ zone valves, BACnet MS/TP application version 01.05.0001.
summary: The CQ24A-BAC is a small rotary actuator for Belimo CQ zone valves with a built-in BACnet MS/TP interface. The BMS writes a 0-100 % position setpoint to AO 1 and reads back relative and absolute position, a summary status and a device status. An override object can force the actuator open, closed or to maximum.
notes: Out-of-range writes to analog objects are clamped to the range limits without an error.
The default of AV 98 Max is not a fixed number; the document says the motor control defines it.

integration.summary: Write the position setpoint to AO 1 and read AI 1 for feedback. Watch BI 101 for a general problem and MI 110 for a bus watchdog trip. If AV 130 is set, the BMS must refresh the setpoint within the timeout.

minimum_points.name: StatusDevice
minimum_points.why: Shows when the bus watchdog has tripped

integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog sets the bus timeout in seconds (0 turns it off; the document gives 120 s as the parameterised default). MI 110 reports 'Bus Watchdog triggered' when it expires.
setup: Parameterised with the Belimo Assistant App.
Max_Master is writable (1-127); writing 0 is raised to 1.
gotchas: Writes outside an analog object's range are clamped silently.
